question: _________ is the science that studies the structure of the body.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anatomy**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Anatomy is the science that studies the** structure of the body.**
 
• Anatomy is a branch of natural science that deals with the** structural organization of living things. **
